domain: Historical Sociology / Legal History / Normative Systems
topic_summary: Analysis of dueling's disappearance from Western societies (roughly 1650-1900), examining whether this represents a simple frequency decline (practice fell to fringe), a structural contraction (became cognitively unthinkable), or an overdetermined composite where multiple mechanisms operated simultaneously.

key_entities: Dueling practice (ritualized lethal combat for honor satisfaction)
State monopoly on violence (emerging centralized legal systems)
key_tensions: Private honor satisfaction vs state monopoly on violence adjudication
Aristocratic status maintenance vs bourgeois reputation mechanisms
Lethal risk acceptance vs financial/familial responsibility

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: Honor as requiring visible, physical risk-taking for satisfaction after insult
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Aristocratic peer recognition; legitimacy grounded in shared code of conduct texts and practice-lineage

readings.commitment: Dueling was a practice that persisted at declining frequency until fringe status
readings.authority_grounding: Statistical/behavioral — measured by duel counts, prosecution records, mentions
readings.expected_structural_delta: Constraint weakens but remains conceptually available; epsilon drops via enforcement and social cost

readings.commitment: Dueling became cognitively unthinkable, a category-level impossibility
readings.authority_grounding: Structural/normative — measured by conceptual availability, not just frequency
readings.expected_structural_delta: Constraint disappears structurally; not merely suppressed but evacuated from possibility space

readings.commitment: Multiple distinct mechanisms operated: state monopoly, bourgeois norms, insurance, category-shift
readings.expected_structural_delta: Constraint eroded via multiple independent extractive pressures plus structural recategorization

axiom_contradictions.basis: Decline assumes the practice remained conceptually available throughout (just suppressed); contraction asserts it became structurally unthinkable. A single framework cannot hold both: either the category persisted as live option or it didn't.

axes.human_readable: Decline Reading: Dueling as Suppressed-But-Available Practice
axes.structural_delta: Frequency decline via rising costs (legal, social, financial) while practice remains conceptually live
axes.primary_observable: Duel frequency over time; prosecution records; persistence in fringe contexts (military, frontier)
axes.selection_reason: First reading: maps statistical suppression mechanism; cleanest empirical observables

axes.human_readable: Contraction Reading: Dueling as Structurally Unthinkable
axes.structural_delta: Category-level evacuation from normative possibility space; not suppressed but conceptually unavailable
axes.primary_observable: Absence in counterfactual reasoning; cultural texts treating it as archaic/absurd rather than merely illegal
axes.selection_reason: Second reading: structural contrast to decline; mountain vs snare type difference

axes.structural_delta: State monopoly + bourgeois norm displacement + insurance/financial + cognitive recategorization as simultaneous pathways
axes.primary_observable: Independent documentation of each mechanism's operation; non-redundant causal pathways
axes.selection_reason: Third reading: synthesis attempting to reconcile decline + contraction via multi-pathway model

axes.structural_delta: Centralization of legitimate force; private violence redefined as criminal
axes.primary_observable: Legal codification of anti-dueling statutes; prosecution success rates; military court-martial records
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: component mechanism within composite; already captured in decline_reading snare structure

axes.structural_delta: Rising middle-class norm system privileging financial prudence and family responsibility over physical courage display
axes.primary_observable: Conduct manual content shifts; insurance contract clauses; bankruptcy/debt records of duelists' families
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: component mechanism within composite; norm-displacement already embedded in composite_reading

axes.structural_delta: Dueling created uninsurable death risk; voided life insurance contracts; exposed families to financial ruin
axes.primary_observable: Life insurance policy dueling exclusion clauses; bankruptcy filings post-duel; credit denial records
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: narrow economic mechanism; lower structural distinctiveness than norm-displacement

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Centralization of legitimate force; private violence criminalized
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Component mechanism already embedded in decline_reading and composite_reading; lower independent yield

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Middle-class prudence norms displacing aristocratic honor culture
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Norm-shift mechanism captured within composite_reading's multi-pathway structure

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Life insurance exclusions and financial ruin risk from dueling death
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Narrow economic pathway; lower structural centrality than norm or state mechanisms

omegas.description: Do decline and contraction readings actually emit different constraints, or do they collapse into one constraint observed from different methodological positions? If contraction is just decline's asymptotic limit (frequency → 0), they may not be genuinely distinct readings. Composite reading's validity depends on this non-collapse holding.

Is contraction_reading a true Mountain (dueling became structurally impossible) or a Rope (collective norm-shift that could reverse)? Classification depends on whether cognitive unavailability is reversible or physically entrenched.

Does composite_reading document genuine causal independence of mechanisms, or are state monopoly/bourgeois norms/insurance merely correlated expressions of one underlying shift? If not independent, composite collapses to decline with multiple symptoms.
omegas.source: §3.1 Pairwise Independence Test + composite_reading causal claims

omegas.description: Dueling persisted in military contexts (officer corps) and frontiers into 20th century. Does this persistence falsify contraction_reading (proving it remained conceptually available), or does it confirm decline_reading's suppression-not-erasure model?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — fringe contexts not addressed in input

omegas.description: Analysis assumes Western European/North American trajectory. Japan (samurai culture), Latin America (machismo honor codes), Middle East (tribal honor systems) had different dueling-analogue trajectories. Are the three readings Western-specific or universal?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) — Western normative framing privilege
